next.reason: 1985 GR17: an OPEN I-O 'must reference a file that supports the input and output operations that are permitted for a sequential file when opened in the I-O mode' and places it in I-O open mode. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR16: 'the file shall support the input and output statements that are permitted for the organization of that file when opened in the I-O mode', '37' and unsuccessful otherwise, success sets I-O mode; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 sets the open mode; §2023:9.1.13.6 GR6 restates the 37 case, which 1985 status 37 also gave. Same run-time requirement for a sequential file.
